$comment: contract=owner-environment-config version=1 status=DRAFT owner_task=INF-001 decisions=D-09,D-21,D-23,D-25,D-32 last_changed=2026-09-28. Owner-supplied, NON-SECRET identifiers per environment (ADR-017 §5). Validated by `make config-validate`. Every property carries x-bridge-secret=false: secrets (passwords, private keys, PATs, webhook URLs with embedded tokens, IdP signing keys, API keys) NEVER go in this file; only the NAME of the AWS Secrets Manager secret or SSM parameter that holds them. Placeholders `<UPPER_SNAKE>` are accepted by this schema so that *.example.yaml templates validate; `make config-validate` rejects any remaining placeholder in a real (non-example) file.
title: Bridge environment configuration (owner-supplied)
description: One file per environment: config/environments/<env>.yaml (template <env>.example.yaml). Holds AWS/Snowflake/GitHub/DNS identifiers, budgets and feature toggles that Terraform, the Snowflake migration runner, CI and the validation dispatcher resolve at plan/apply time. Commit real values only after the repository is private (ADR-017 §5).

schema_version.description: Version of this configuration schema. Bumped only with a new schema major (CONVENTIONS §13).

environment.description: Environment this file configures. Must equal the file name stem (dev.yaml → dev).

organization.description: AWS Organization-wide identifiers (INF-001, G-INF-12). Identical in every environment file; `make config-validate` checks cross-file equality.

management_account_id.description: Management (payer) account: billing and Organizations only; SCPs do not apply to it.

security_account_id.description: Security account: GuardDuty / Security Hub / IAM Access Analyzer delegated administrator.

log_archive_account_id.description: Log-archive account: organization CloudTrail bucket, Config aggregator, flow/resolver log archive.

shared_services_account_id.description: Shared-services account: ECR, image-signing KMS key, apex Route 53 zone, release-evidence bucket.

recovery_account_id.description: Optional separate recovery account for the ADR-011/OPS-007 recovery bucket. Omit to use the log-archive account.

account_email_domain.description: Domain of the root e-mail aliases of member accounts (aws+<account-name>@<domain>). A role mailbox domain, not a personal address.

identity_center.description: IAM Identity Center instance used for human AWS access (permission sets BridgeAdmin/BridgeOperator/BridgeDeveloper/BridgeReadOnly/BridgeBilling).

region.description: Home region of the Identity Center instance.

external_idp.description: External SAML IdP feeding Identity Center, if any (FND owner question 1). NONE = Identity Center directory.

aws.description: Workload account of this environment (dev, staging or prod).

account_id.description: 12-digit AWS account ID of this environment. Terraform `allowed_account_ids` and tools/tf/tf.sh refuse any other caller account.

region.description: Primary region. R1 is a single EU deployment (D-23): eu-west-1.

global_region.description: Region for CloudFront-scoped resources (ACM for CloudFront and Cognito custom domain, CLOUDFRONT WAF, CloudFront alarms). Always us-east-1.

az_ids.description: Exactly two AZ IDs (not names) used for subnets a and b, e.g. euw1-az1, euw1-az2. AZ IDs are stable across accounts; AZ names are not.

reserved_az_id.description: Third AZ ID whose CIDR blocks are reserved (AZ-c, infra/network/cidr-plan.yaml).

support_plan.description: AWS Support plan of this account (INF owner question 5).

dns.description: Public DNS names (INF-006-S01). The apex zone lives in shared-services; each environment gets a delegated sub-zone.

apex_hosted_zone_id.description: Route 53 public hosted zone ID of the apex domain in the shared-services account.

environment_zone_name.description: Delegated environment zone, e.g. dev.<apex> / staging.<apex>; prod may use <apex> itself.

environment_hosted_zone_id.description: Filled after INF-006 apply when the environment zone is a separate hosted zone.

auth_hostname.description: Cognito custom domain (certificate in us-east-1, INF-006-S12).

email.description: SES sending identity (INF-006-S11; single owner per RECONCILIATION U-07).

sender_domain.description: SES domain identity, the sending subdomain notify.<domain>.

mail_from_domain.description: Custom MAIL FROM domain (MX + SPF), e.g. mail.notify.<domain>.

from_address.description: Envelope/visible sender, a role address such as no-reply@notify.<domain>.

dmarc_policy.description: Current DMARC policy; starts at NONE and moves to QUARANTINE after 30 clean days (G-INF-15).

github.description: Repository identity used in GitHub OIDC trust policies (INF-102-S01/S02, INF-007-S09). The customized `sub` claim includes repository_owner_id and repository_id so a renamed or re-created repository cannot assume Bridge roles.

organization.description: GitHub organization (or user) login owning the repository.

repository_owner_id.description: Numeric owner ID (from the GitHub API), as a string.

repository_id.description: Numeric repository ID (from the GitHub API), as a string.

environment_name.description: GitHub environment bound to this AWS environment's apply/deploy roles (protection rules configured in GitHub).

runner_label.description: Label of the in-VPC ephemeral runner of this environment (INF-002-S09).

visibility.description: Repository visibility as confirmed by the owner. Real values in this file require PRIVATE (ADR-017 §5); `make config-validate` refuses a non-example file when this is PUBLIC.

snowflake.description: Snowflake identifiers (INF-008, INF-101, FND-101). Machine access is WIF only (D-21); no password, key pair or PAT is ever configured.

central.description: Central Bridge account of this environment (BRIDGE_DEV / BRIDGE_STAGING / BRIDGE_PROD; G-INF-17).

sso.description: SAML2 security integration for human users of the central account (INF-008-S03, FND-101). Public IdP metadata only; the IdP signing certificate is public but long, so its SSM parameter name is stored.

idp_issuer.description: SAML2 issuer / entity ID of the IdP.

idp_certificate_ssm_parameter.description: SSM parameter NAME holding the IdP X.509 signing certificate (public).

test_estate.description: Non-production Snowflake test estate (INF-101; U-03). Declared only in staging.yaml because the estate's IaC and connector roles run from the STAGING AWS account (INF-101-S05/S10).

alias.description: Account alias from the test-estate specification.

monthly_credit_cap.description: Resource-monitor quota in credits (INF-101-S09); sum over the estate ≤ 150 (D-32).

notifications.description: Where platform alarms, budget alerts and test deliveries go. Webhook URLs that embed tokens are secrets: only the Secrets Manager secret NAME is stored here.

ops_alert_email.description: Role mailbox for operational alarms (SNS e-mail subscription).

cost_alert_email.description: Role mailbox for AWS Budgets, Cost Anomaly Detection and Snowflake resource-monitor notices (INF-105, INF-008-S16).

security_alert_email.description: Role mailbox for root-login, SCP/trail change and break-glass alarms (INF-001-S06/S13).

chat_webhook_secret_name.description: Secrets Manager secret NAME holding the ops chat webhook URL (the URL is a secret).

test_destinations.description: Destinations used by live delivery gates (GOV-007, RPT) in this environment. Never customer destinations.

email_recipients.description: Test inboxes owned by Bridge (while SES is in sandbox these must be verified identities).

slack_webhook_secret_name.description: Secret NAME of the Slack test-channel incoming webhook.

teams_webhook_secret_name.description: Secret NAME of the Teams Workflows test webhook.

webhook_receiver_url.description: HTTPS URL of a Bridge-owned generic webhook receiver used by delivery tests. Must not embed a token or query string; the signing secret is created by the product (Standard Webhooks).

budgets.description: Owner-approved ceilings (INF-105-S01, D-32). Money values are decimal strings in USD (CONVENTIONS §5); credits are decimal strings.

aws_monthly_usd.description: AWS Budget of this environment's account (proposal: dev 450, staging 1000, prod 2500).

organization_accounts_monthly_usd.description: Budget per organization account (management, security, log-archive, shared-services); proposal 40 each. Identical across files.

actual_alert_pct.description: Thresholds on ACTUAL spend, percent of budget.

anomaly_absolute_usd.description: Cost Anomaly Detection absolute impact threshold (dev/staging 50, prod 100).

anomaly_relative_pct.description: Cost Anomaly Detection relative impact threshold (dev/staging 20, prod 15).

snowflake_central_monthly_credits.description: Account-level resource-monitor quota of the central account (dev 150, staging 200). In prod this is the notify-only account monitor; warehouse monitors come from infra/snowflake/objects.yaml.

snowflake_nonprod_ceiling_credits.description: Monthly ceiling for all non-production Snowflake use (D-32: 500). Identical across files.

egress.description: NAT Elastic IPs of this environment (D-09). Left empty by the owner; filled from `terraform output` after INF-002 apply and then published to infra/environments/<env>.egress.json, SSM /bridge/<env>/egress/ips and GET /v1/platform/egress-ips.

features.description: Owner feature toggles for infrastructure choices that carry cost or policy impact.

interface_endpoints.description: Create the 9 interface endpoints (INF-002-S05). false in dev (NAT only); true in staging (1 AZ) and prod (2 AZ). The conftest cost rule rejects true in dev.

guardduty_ecs_runtime_monitoring.description: GuardDuty ECS runtime monitoring (per-vCPU charge; INF owner question 7).

security_hub_fsbp.description: Security Hub AWS Foundational Security Best Practices standard.

snowflake_account_network_policy.description: Account-level Snowflake network policy restricted to the environment EIPs (true in staging/prod; false in dev where humans use SSO, INF-008-S06).

dev_off_hours_scale_to_zero.description: Scale ECS services to zero 20:00–07:00 UTC and weekends (INF-105-S07). Only honoured in dev.

broker_transport.description: D-22 API→broker transport: VPC Lattice with IAM auth (preferred) or Service Connect + security group fallback.

dagster_admin_webserver.description: Keep the write-enabled Dagster webserver service at desired 1 (break-glass only). Normally false.

dns_firewall_custom_allowlist_mode.description: Mode of the custom DNS Firewall allowlist rule group (managed threat lists are always BLOCK).

cur_export.description: CUR 2.0 Data Export for OPS-009 (INF-105-S05). Configured once, in the prod file, for the whole organization.

placeholder.description: Template placeholder such as <AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_DEV>. Accepted by the schema for *.example.yaml; rejected by `make config-validate` in real files.

secret_name.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret NAME (never its value).

decimal_string.description: Non-negative decimal string (CONVENTIONS §5); never a JSON/YAML number.

snowflake_account.description: A Snowflake account identity. account_url is derived as https://<organization_name>-<account_name>.snowflakecomputing.com (underscores in the account name become hyphens in the host).

account_name.description: Account name within the organization, e.g. BRIDGE_DEV.

account_locator.description: Account locator (legacy identifier; kept verbatim, CONVENTIONS §3).

region.description: Snowflake region ID, e.g. AWS_EU_WEST_1, AZURE_WESTEUROPE.
